searchText: At the Fulu->Gloas boundary, if the last Fulu slot is skipped, the Fulu attestations for that slot (which carry EIP-7549 data.index = 0) get included in first Gloas block and are scored under Gloas rules,where data.index is interpreted as payload vote Since the attestation is not same slot, this function https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/477321355d48d527e7e1e4d572f6a40a0b41072a/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md?plain=1#L1361-L1368 compares legacy zero (data.index = 0) against execution_payload_availability (which upgrade_to_gloas initialized to 1 for all pre-fork slots) Impact: Vote mismatch and attestors lose timely head flag despite being correct This is a spec bug. Clients impl the spec faithfully, so they inherit the bug Hey <@534690469121359882> thanks for this. I don't think it's worth fixing honestly. I'd be more afraid of introducing a consensus bug at this point. A fix would be simple but a little ugly imo. <@586161934425128960> <@755590043632140352> what do you guys think? I would prefer to not change anything at this point in time. I think it's valid, not useful to fix but very useful to test this scenario in case clients are treating this differently than the spec. In fact of the top of my head I don't even know what Prysm does in this case so it'd be nice to test that we don't have a chain split with this. <@199561711278227457> you have the tools to do this on kurtosis right? just censor the last Fulu blocks in a couple of runs with all CL clients? what do you need? wdym by `just censor the last Fulu blocks in a couple of runs with all CL clients` - no blocks being produced or gossiped so its listed as missing? Just anything to cause them to be missed slots. I would probably just hardcode the nodes not to propose during those slots. With some new condition added to their clients; a patch. how many slots do you need to be missing and what am i observing post fork? should be easy to do it with disruptoor Just the last fulu slot needs to be missing. We'd be looking for a consensus split; if one or more clients reward attestations from the fulu slot (included in the first gloas block) differently. According to <@534690469121359882>'s report, all clients should agree. > Clients impl the spec faithfully, so they inherit the bug no need, they already have tooling to prevent the block from propagating just the last one in Fulu is good enough and make sure that the first one in Gloas is included that's important If there's no split, how do you think we should proceed? not do anything about this The spec is not wrong we can probably add a test the spec is just unfair but that's irrelevant Well attesters in this situation would miss out on a reward. yeah I don't care attesters **always** miss a reward in case a block is missed and that's part of life, we're not fixing it Yeah I agree. Sounds good 👍 no one that voted on N gets timely head if N+1 decides not to propose even if they got it right this happens every slot, so adding one more case at a fork is kinda irrelevant
